name: What is the difference between a custom home and a production home?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom home and a production home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom home is uniquely designed and built to the specific preferences of a single homeowner on a particular piece of land. It offers unparalleled flexibility in architectural style, layout, materials, and finishes. In contrast, a production home (or spec home) is built by a developer on a pre-selected lot, often as part of a larger community, using standardized plans and limited customization options. Production homes are typically less expensive and quicker to build, while custom homes offer bespoke quality and design.
acceptedAnswer.description: A custom home is uniquely designed for an individual homeowner, offering full personalization. A production home uses standardized plans in a development with limited customization.
